messages:
sara_partnerships: Hey team — Mosaic sent over the final solution brief + one-page case study. Can we do a quick asset sanity check? Need: logo variants (svg/png), dark-bg treatment, alt text, and legal OK on the customer quote. Link: https://mosaic-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/mosaic-redwood-package.zip

ian_design: grabbing the zip now. Can we get an `svg` for the logo plus a white-lockup for dark backgrounds? Also need explicit clearspace/padding spec (px or %).

marta_legal: flag — we need written permission to use the customer quote and a signed release for the headshot if they gave one. If Mosaic already has consent, ask them to attach it here. Also confirm trademark line to render under the logo (™ vs ®).

leo_marketing: for marketplace listing we need: alt text, CTA copy (1 short line), and a 1200x600 hero image (jpeg/png). Suggested CTA: "See demo: Redwood + Mosaic". Also please confirm whether the case study quote can be shortened to a one-sentence pull quote for the hero.

sara_partnerships: Files inside zip: `mosaic_logo.svg`, `mosaic_logo_white.png`, `mosaic_logo_darklockup.svg`, `solution_brief_v4.pdf`, `one_pager_case_study_v2.pdf`, `headshot_jdoe.jpg`, `quote_release_signed.pdf` (looks like Mosaic attached a release).

partner-marcom-bot: Mosaic uploaded a new file: quote_release_signed.pdf (uploaded by mosaic_marketing) — 1993456795

mosaic_marketing: Quick reply from our side — we confirm permission to use the quote and headshot in Redwood marketing and the cloud marketplace. Preferred alt text below.

mosaic_marketing: Alt text suggestion: "Two engineers reviewing deployment metrics in a control plane dashboard; Mosaic and Redwood logos in the header."

marta_legal: Thanks — I see the `quote_release_signed.pdf`. I'll review but looks like it has the needed language. One ask: change quote attribution to include company name (not just initials). Otherwise OK.

ian_design: For design deliverables I'll: export `mosaic_logo.svg` -> provide `mosaic_logo_432.svg`, `mosaic_logo_128.svg` and PNGs at 2x/1x. For dark backgrounds i'll use `mosaic_logo_white.svg` and include a 16px clearspace spec (equal to the height of the logomark). Proposing we add a white lockup with subtle drop shadow for marketplace tile to preserve contrast.

leo_marketing: Can we also get a short pull quote version? Original: "Redwood and Mosaic cut inference cost by 48% and reduced latency by half — our deployment is production-ready." Proposed shortened: "Cut inference cost by 48% and halved latency." Mosaic ok?

mosaic_marketing: Shortened quote approved. Use company name for attribution: "— Jordan Doe, CTO, Mosaic Systems". Headshot high-res link: https://mosaic-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/jdoe-hr.jpg

marta_legal: Good, that attribution language is fine. I'll add a one-line clause we store internally: "Quote released for use in marketing and product collateral, no geographic restrictions." Documented.

ian_design: Uploading exports to shared folder now. Will include `README.txt` with padding/specs and export filenames.

sara_partnerships: Great — action items: Ian (exports + dark tile variant) by EOD PT, Marta (final sign-off) by EOD, Leo (final CTA + alt text confirmation) by tomorrow. If everyone OK, I'll schedule marketplace publish for next Tuesday. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

leo_marketing: :thumbsup: all good from marketing.

mosaic_marketing: :thumbsup: thanks, excited to go live.

marta_legal: :eyes: I'll finish review and leave final comment in the doc.

ian_design: Done — uploads complete: https://redwood-shared.s3.amazonaws.com/partnerships/mosaic/exports/ (contains specs + 3 svg/png variants).

sara_partnerships: Closing loop here — schedule set for Tuesday publish. Will ping again if anything blocks. Thanks everyone!
